problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a convex function f: ℝ^d → ℝ with an attained global minimum.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GapGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.Instance and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.admissible, ConvexOn and minimizer clauses.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Each query x returns ∇f(x), without function values or oracle error. The gradient identity holds for every history and oracle seed, so replies at a fixed point cannot vary with either. Algorithms may be randomized and query arbitrary points; cost counts individual gradient queries.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.admissible, HasGradientAt clause; LongTails/Setups/GapGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.Query and spec.Reply; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm, executeWithTrace, and Setup.allowedAlgorithm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is differentiable everywhere and satisfies ‖D(∇f)(x)‖ ≤ L0 + L1‖∇f(x)‖ globally, with L0 > 0 and L1 ≥ 0. Continuity of the Hessian is not explicitly required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.admissible, Differentiable and fderiv clauses; LongTails/Setups/GapGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean geometry on ℝ^d, with d ≥ ⌈2^80(1 + L1 R + √(L0 R²/ε))^10⌉.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: There exists a common minimizer xstar satisfying ‖x0 − xstar‖ ≤ R and f(x0) − f(xstar) ≤ Δ. All parameters d, L0, L1, x0, R, Δ, ε are public. Validity requires R > 0, ε > 0, ε ≤ L0 R²/16, and Δ ≥ 16ε.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.admissible, final existential clause; LongTails/Setups/GapGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and spec.valid.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Output an arbitrary point xhat ∈ ℝ^d with integrable objective gap and E[f(xhat) − f(xstar)] ≤ ε for a global minimizer xstar. The output need not be a queried point or a specified iterate.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee is in expectation over the joint algorithm and oracle seed law; no almost-sure or high-probability accuracy requirement is imposed.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GapGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.successful, integral inequality; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, product probability law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: This variant combines gradient-dependent curvature with public radius and initial-gap bounds and an explicit large-dimension restriction, beyond the classical globally Lipschitz-gradient convex benchmark.

descriptionHtml:
Gap-Constrained Generalized Smooth Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing a convex function f:Rd→R in a prescribed high-dimensional regime. The function f is (L0,L1)-smooth, with L0>0 and L1≥0, and has a differentiable gradient. A given point x0∈Rd satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ for a global minimizer x⋆, where R,Δ>0. The oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. Given ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈Rd with integrable objective gap satisfying EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Rdf(x). We use the Euclidean norm, and ∥⋅∥op denotes its induced operator norm. The parameters satisfy d∈N,L0>0,L1≥0,R>0,0<ε≤L0R216,16ε≤Δ,d≥⌈280(1+L1R+L0R2ε)10⌉. The algorithm receives d,L0,L1,x0,R,Δ, and ε.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity). For every x,y∈Rd and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y).

Assumption 2 (Generalized smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere, its gradient is Fréchet differentiable everywhere, and ∥∇2f(x)∥op≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥,x∈Rd.

Assumption 3 (Initial distance and objective gap). There exists x⋆∈Rd such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈Rd,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ.

Queries may be made at any point of Rd. After the allotted oracle calls, the output must have an integrable objective gap and satisfy EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε. The minimizer x⋆ is fixed independently of the algorithm’s randomness; all global minimizers have the same objective value.

comparisonHtml:
Convex f:Rd→R has differentiable gradient satisfying ∥∇2f(x)∥≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥, and a minimizer x⋆ with ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ. Here L0,R,ε>0, L1≥0, ε≤L0R2/16, Δ≥16ε, and d≥⌈280(1+L1R+L0R2/ε)10⌉. Unrestricted randomized algorithms receive exact gradients. The target is integrable loss with ∫[f(x^(ω))−f(x⋆)]dP(ω)≤ε, for the algorithm’s probability law P. All rows are lower bounds (necessary budgets).

import LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt

namespace LongTails.Setups.GapGeneralizedSmoothConvex

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory

structure Params where
  d : ℕ
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  x0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  R : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

noncomputable abbrev Params.toGeneralized (p : Params) : GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.Params :=
  { E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d), L0 := p.L0, L1 := p.L1, x0 := p.x0,
    R := p.R, Δ := p.Δ, ε := p.ε }

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d) → ℝ
  Query p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Reply p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Output p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  publicInput := id
  valid p := 0 < p.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ p.L1 ∧ 0 < p.R ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧
    p.ε ≤ p.L0 * p.R ^ 2 / 16 ∧ 16 * p.ε ≤ p.Δ ∧
    ⌈1208925819614629174706176 * (1 + p.L1 * p.R + Real.sqrt (p.L0 * p.R ^ 2 / p.ε)) ^ 10⌉₊ ≤ p.d
  admissible p := GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.spec.admissible p.toGeneralized
  successful p f output P :=
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => f (output ω) - f xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, f (output ω) - f xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.GapGeneralizedSmoothConvex
